name: llm-guard-extension
description: LLM Guard v3 — Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that anonymizes or blocks PII in prompts sent to LLM services.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.source:firefox: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('web-ext-artifacts',{recursive:true})" && tar -czf web-ext-artifacts/avopseudo-source.tar.gz src manifest.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json eslint.config.js package.json package-lock.json RELEASE.md render-icons.mjs
scripts.release:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npm run lint:firefox && npm run source:firefox && npm run sign:firefox
